title: 第十章 华雄又跑了

content_zh:
“吕将军，且勿多言，容公路细细说来。”袁绍对吕布的行径十分不爽，这年头大家都想着做文绉绉的人，谁会喜欢一个武夫。
孙坚投向吕布一个感激的眼神“请盟主给我手下将士一个说法。”
袁术不愧是见多识广，编故事的本领若说第二，无人敢称第一，一番话下来，他反倒成了英明的将军，仿佛孙坚兵败将罪责归咎于他是错误的。
帐内其他诸侯窃窃私语，显然为袁术编故事的本领折服了。
“袁公路管理粮草有过，命其立即发粮与孙将军，孙将军首战有功，赏良马五十匹，金百两。”
见其余诸侯大部分心向袁绍二人，孙坚只能领命。
“盟主，吕将军此番率军救援孙将军，击退华雄，乃是大功一件。”公孙瓒上前道。
“哼，未经允许，私自出兵，念其有功，功过相抵，不做奖赏。”袁绍冷哼道，怎么说他与袁术也是兄弟，在外人面前折了面子，自然很不舒服。
“盟主。”曹操神色微变，上前道：“孙将军身陷重围，吕将军虽擅自出兵相救，却没使我军折损大将，不得不赏啊。”
袁绍不满的看了曹操一眼啊，沉思良久道：“功劳暂且记下，待来日攻破董贼之后再行定夺。”
吕布轻轻拉了正欲上前计较的孙坚一把，微微摇了摇头，他压根没想着要什么封赏，从这件事也可以看出，诸侯中并不是表面上的一团和气，涉及的到利益的时候，恐怕一个个都会撕破伪装的面具。
“报，华雄引铁骑下关，在寨前大骂搦战。”
“鲍忠之弟不听军令，为华雄所斩，而今孙将军又败于敌手，何人敢出战？”袁绍叹道。
话音刚落，袁术身后的俞涉狠狠瞪了吕布一眼，抱拳道：“小将愿往，定取华雄人头。”
袁绍闻言大喜，急忙命令俞涉出战华雄，对袁术的不满减少了很多。
吕布毫不在意俞涉的怒视，叹道：“打酱油的始终是打酱油的啊。”
“奉先此言何意？什么是打酱油？”孙坚疑问道，一旁的公孙瓒曹操也投来好奇的目光。
“哦，这是我的家乡话，意思是不中用，不出所料，俞涉不出五合必定被斩！”吕布对诸侯讨董第一个跑龙套的还是有一定印象的。
“吕布小儿，休要胡说，俞涉乃是本将军帐下大将。”袁术刚才被踹了一脚，心中十分不爽。
“报，俞涉将军与华雄战不三合，被华雄斩于马下。”

众人闻言大惊，袁术更是气的捂住胸口指着吕布嘴唇直哆嗦，在他看来就是因为吕布的诅咒，本想着在诸侯面前出一口气，谁知道折了手下大将。
“何人敢出战？”袁绍环视众人一眼，脸色铁青的问道。
冀州刺史韩馥上前道：“我有上将潘凤，可斩华雄。”
袁绍急忙令潘凤出战。
“可惜了一员上将。”吕布轻叹。
“莫非吕将军认为潘凤不是华雄对手？”孙坚压低声音问道。
“且看结果吧。”吕布急忙闭嘴，这个时候说丧气话可是得罪人的，袁术就算了，韩馥毕竟是冀州刺史，冀州和并州邻近，别什么时候给自己小鞋穿。
“报，潘凤被华雄斩了。”
诸侯闻言大惊，没想到华雄竟有这等本领，袁绍叹道：“可惜吾上将颜良文丑未至，否则区区华雄，何足惧也。”
孙坚正在气头上，不可能派手下将领出战，而吕布又不会去做出头鸟。
一直冷眼旁观的关羽冷哼一声，出列道；：“小将愿往，斩华雄之头，献于帐下。”
众人视之，见其人身长九尺，髯长二尺，丹凤眼，卧蚕眉，面如重枣，声如洪钟，端的是一名好汉。
“此乃何人？”袁绍见关羽仪表不凡，颇有大将之威，急忙问道。
“此乃刘玄德之弟关羽也。”公孙瓒解释道。
“现居何职？”袁绍追问道。
“跟随刘玄德，是为马弓手。”公孙瓒如实道。
“汝欺吾众诸侯没有大将？一个小小的马弓手，也敢在这里口出狂言，来人啊，乱棍打出去。”袁术感觉胸中憋着一股气，被吕布欺负了，手下的大将折了，竟然还有一个马弓手跳出来，简直没天理了。
“哼，此人先前就羞辱大哥，这又羞辱二哥，俺老张……”张飞怒发冲冠，之前吕布没回来的时候，袁绍问到刘备三人时，袁术就在一旁冷言相加。

content_en:
"General Lu, please don't say too much. I'll tell you in detail." Yuan Shao was very dissatisfied with Lu Bu's behavior. These days, everyone is thinking about being a literary person, so who would like a martial artist.
Sun Jian cast a grateful look at Lu Bu and said, "Please, leader of the alliance, give an explanation to my soldiers."
Yuan Shu was indeed well-informed, and no one dared to claim him as the second best at making up stories. After what he said, he turned out to be a wise general, as if it was wrong to blame him for Sun Jian's defeat.
The other princes in the tent were whispering, obviously impressed by Yuan Shu's ability to make up stories.
"Yuan Gongdao had a problem with managing grain and grass. He ordered him to immediately distribute grain to General Sun. General Sun had meritorious service in the first battle and was rewarded with fifty good horses and one hundred taels of gold."
Seeing that most of the other princes were interested in Yuan Shao and Yuan Shao, Sun Jian could only accept the order.
"Alliance leader, it is a great achievement that General Lu led his army to rescue General Sun and repel Hua Xiong." Gongsun Zan stepped forward and said.
"Hmph, you send troops privately without permission. If you think you have merit, your merits will be equal to your faults, and you won't be rewarded." Yuan Shao snorted coldly. After all, he and Yuan Shu are also brothers. He lost face in front of outsiders, so he was naturally very uncomfortable.
"Alliance leader." Cao Cao's expression changed slightly, and he stepped forward and said, "General Sun is trapped in a tight siege. Although General Lu sent troops to rescue without permission, he did not cause our army to lose the general, so we have to reward him."
Yuan Shao glanced at Cao Cao dissatisfied, thought for a long time and said: "Let's record the merits for now, and we will make a decision after defeating Dong's thieves in the future."
Lu Bu gently pulled Sun Jian, who was about to step forward to argue, and shook his head slightly. He didn't even think about asking for any reward. From this incident, it can be seen that the princes are not all harmonious on the surface. When interests are involved, I am afraid that every one of them will tear off the mask of disguise.
"Reported that Hua Xiong led his cavalry down the pass and cursed in front of the stronghold, provoking a fight."
"Bao Zhong's brother disobeyed military orders and was killed by Hua Xiong. Now General Sun has been defeated by the enemy. Who dares to go to war?" Yuan Shao sighed.
As soon as he finished speaking, Yu She who was behind Yuan Shu glared at Lu Bu fiercely, cupped his fists and said, "Young general, if you are willing to go, I will take Hua Xiong's head."
Yuan Shao was overjoyed when he heard this and hurriedly ordered Yu She to fight against Hua Xiong. His dissatisfaction with Yuan Shu was greatly reduced.
Lu Bu didn't care about Yu She's glare and sighed: "Those who make soy sauce are always those who make soy sauce."
"What do you mean by Fengxian's words? What is soy sauce?" Sun Jian asked, and Gongsun Zan and Cao Cao on the side also cast curious eyes.
"Oh, this is my hometown dialect, which means useless. As expected, Yu She will be beheaded if he doesn't come out of Wuhe!" Lu Bu still had a certain impression of the princes who were the first to act as a side hustle in their fight against Dong.
"Little Lu Bu, don't talk nonsense. Yu She is my general's general." Yuan Shu was kicked just now and felt very unhappy.
"Reportedly, General Yu She and Hua Xiong fought against each other and were killed by Hua Xiong."
Everyone was shocked when they heard this, and Yuan Shu was so angry that he covered his chest and pointed at Lu Bu, his lips trembling. In his opinion, it was because of Lu Bu's curse that he wanted to express his anger in front of the princes, but he lost his general.
"Who dares to fight?" Yuan Shao looked around at everyone and asked with a livid face.
Han Fu, the governor of Jizhou, stepped forward and said, "I have General Pan Feng who can kill Hua Xiong."
Yuan Shao quickly ordered Pan Feng to fight.
"It's a pity that we lost a general." Lu Bu sighed.
"Could General Lu think that Pan Feng is not Hua Xiong's opponent?" Sun Jian asked in a low voice.
"Let's see the result." Lu Bu hurriedly shut up. It would be offensive to say depressing words at this time. Forget Yuan Shu. After all, Han Fu is the governor of Jizhou. Jizhou and Bingzhou are close to each other. Don't put your own shoes on.
"Reportedly, Pan Feng was beheaded by Hua Xiong."
The princes were shocked when they heard this. They didn't expect Hua Xiong to have such abilities. Yuan Shao sighed: "It's a pity that my general Yan Liangwen Chou has not arrived yet. Otherwise, there is nothing to fear about Hua Xiong."
Sun Jian was so angry that he could not send his generals to fight, and Lu Bu would not take the lead.
Always keeping a cold eyeGuan Yu, who was watching, snorted coldly and stepped out of the queue: "Young general, I would like to go, cut off Hua Xiong's head and offer it under the tent."
When everyone looked at him, they saw that he was nine feet long, with a beard two feet long, red phoenix eyes, silkworm eyebrows, a face like a heavy jujube, and a voice like a loud bell. He was carrying a good man.
"Who is this?" Yuan Shao asked hurriedly when he saw that Guan Yu had an extraordinary appearance and was quite powerful as a general.
"This is Guan Yu, Liu Xuande's younger brother." Gongsun Zan explained.
"What is your current position?" Yuan Shao asked.
"Following Liu Xuande is a horse archer." Gongsun Zan said truthfully.
"You are deceiving all the princes that we have no generals? A small horse archer dares to speak arrogant words here. Come on, hit him with a stick." Yuan Shu felt that he was holding a breath in his chest. He was bullied by Lu Bu. His general was defeated, and there was a horse archer jumping out. It was simply unreasonable.
"Humph, this person humiliated the eldest brother before, and now he humiliates the second brother, I, Lao Zhang..." Zhang Fei was furious. When Yuan Shao asked about Liu Bei and the other three before Lu Bu came back, Yuan Shu said coldly to him.
